verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an agent platform, but the evidence never documents a scheduler, cron, or recurring trigger for agents or workflows. The visual workflow builder covers multi-step conversation flows, not time-based recurrence. Webhook tools that can book meetings are a one-off action an agent takes during a conversation, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
